slides.notes: Introduce the question: how to fine-tune reasoning models cheaply with RL without breaking them.

content.text: RLVR mostly ==re-weights what the model already knows== – it barely moves the principal weight directions.
content.source: Paper §2.1, summarising Zhu et al. 2025; Wu et al. 2025

slides.notes: SFT injects knowledge via principal directions; RLVR updates are small, off-principal and concentrated in small sub-networks.

content.title: Two fine-tuning regimes, two update geometries
Existing PEFT methods miss one of two goals

slides.notes: Goal: RL-aligned like sparse FT, dense like LoRA.

content.title: Same adapter shape, different starting point
content.meaning: Fig. 1: how LoRA, PiSSA, MiLoRA and GeoRA initialise the adapter, and GeoRA's forward pass
content.caption: Figure 1 from the paper (Zhang et al., 2026)

zoom.label: INITIALISATION
zoom.text: SVD of the ==geometry-constrained== matrix $W_{Geo}$, not of $W$. Its top-$r$ components initialise $A_{Geo}$ and $B_{Geo}$.

zoom.label: FINE-TUNING
zoom.text: A frozen ==residual matrix== keeps the output unchanged at step 0 and anchors the pre-trained structure.

slides.notes: Walk through the four columns, then zoom into GeoRA and into the forward pass.

content.title: In-domain: best low-rank method, on par with full FT
content.takeaway: AIME24, Qwen3-8B after math RLVR: ==23.8%== vs. 19.6% for LoRA.

content.title: Out-of-domain: math training hurts coding less
content.takeaway: HumanEval after ==math-only== RLVR: GeoRA 82.9 – PiSSA drops below the base model.

content.text: trainable parameters vs. full FT – and ==20% faster== per step with 28% less VRAM.

slides.notes: Table 3: 0.04B vs 8B params; 185 vs 231 s/it; 68.4% vs 95.7% VRAM. SparseFT is slower than full FT.

content.title: Questions we would ask the authors
body: AIME24 gap to full FT is ≈ 0.4 pt: what is the seed variance?
Main runs fix $\rho = 0.2$ and $r = 16$: how sensitive is GeoRA?
Do the masks transfer beyond GRPO?

slides.notes: Placeholder for the team's own analysis (bonus: beyond the paper). Appendix D reports rank/sparsity sweeps – check before presenting.

content.message: Initialise where RL wants to move – and freeze the rest.
takeaways: RLVR updates are low-rank and off-principal
GeoRA: masked SVD init + frozen residual
Full-FT accuracy at 0.5% of the parameters
